evidence.title: International Applicant Info - Berea College
evidence.excerpt: FL, IELTS, SAT, ACT or Duolingo. The minimum score required for each test is: TOEFL: 520 (paper-based); 190 (computer-based); 68 (internet-based) IELTS: 6 overall, 5 in each area ACT: 19 Composite SAT: 980 Combined Score Duolingo: 95 Berea will almost never consider scores from a test taken more
